papers.title: LimiX-2: A Contextual Mechanism Network Towards General Structured-Data Intelligence
papers.desc: We introduce LimiX-2, a new model in the LimiX family, developed through model and data scaling guided by our previously established scaling laws.

papers.title: Rethinking Critic Learning in PPO: Understanding and Mitigating Value Flattening
papers.desc: In reinforcement learning for large language models, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) commonly uses a critic to estimate state values and reduce the variance of policy updates.

papers.title: Confidence Comes from Experience: Experiential Confidence Estimation from Reasoning to Agents
papers.desc: Reliable confidence estimation is increasingly central to the trustworthy deployment of language models: a calibrated estimate of the probability that an output is correct decides what to ship, what to escalate, and what to retry.

papers.title: ActionPiece: Rethinking Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.desc: Action tokenizers play a central role in autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models, determining both the targets for policy training and the executable commands recovered from predicted tokens.

papers.title: Zing-0.5: Toward Playable Worlds with Real-Time Joint Action and Text Control
papers.desc: We introduce Zing-0.5, a 5B autoregressive world model designed for playability: users can explore generated worlds, influence unfolding events, and respond to the resulting feedback through joint keyboard and online text control.

papers.title: SpectralShift: Effective Context Window Extension of Gated DeltaNet via Spectral Reparameterization
papers.desc: Recently, linear attention layers have been increasingly adopted to replace softmax attention at scale for long-context modeling.

papers.title: A Zeroth-Order Paradigm for LLM Preference Alignment
papers.desc: Direct preference alignment methods are widely used to align large language models (LLMs) with human preferences because of their computational and memory efficiency.

papers.title: In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents
papers.desc: Enabling robots to adapt to unfamiliar environments as readily as humans remains a moonshot goal of embodied AI.

papers.title: PANORAMA: Panoptic Grounded Captioning via Mask Proposal Selection
papers.desc: Intelligent systems that act in the world require image understanding that is both comprehensive and spatially grounded.

papers.title: Flattening Every Memory Peak in Long-Context Mixture-of-Experts Training
papers.desc: Training a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model at long context or large batch size fails as soon as any one component's peak allocation exceeds device memory, so the target is every peak at once, not the average footprint.

papers.title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction
papers.desc: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) inference on consumer hardware is bounded by weight memory: a 35B-class model is 19.5GB at 4-bit, and sparsity shrinks the compute per token, not the bytes that must be held.

papers.title: CERA-MoA: Co-Evolving Routing Mechanisms with Continually Learning LLM Agents
papers.desc: Current Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) paradigms generally treat query routing and agent fine-tuning as separate processes, limiting their ability to respond to evolving agent capabilities.

papers.title: Fathom: Per-Query Read Depth for Sparse Decoding over Offloaded KV Caches
papers.desc: When agentic sessions run to a million tokens with many sessions resident at once, the KV cache and the index that ranks it live in host memory, and the scan that ranks all n keys for a top-k step becomes the traffic that bounds decoding.

papers.title: Fingers as Legs: Learning Self-Supported Locomotion and Manipulation with an Anthropomorphic Hand
papers.desc: A walking robotic hand must use the same fingers to move its body, support its weight, and interact with the environment.

papers.title: Assessing nnU-Net Generalization across Brain Tumor Populations in BraTS-GoAT 2026
papers.desc: BraTS-GoAT evaluates tumor segmentation across heterogeneous populations.
